column2: Phew, is that all you've got...? ||| How disappointing. ||| With skill like that, you'd only lose to Jack. ||| I know it's harsh, but rules are rules. As promised, you'll have to go home for today. ||| Heh, come back after you've trained a bit more.
Obtained 5000 Mira.
...I'm surprised. You're pretty good. ||| Heh, all right. I'll go tell Jack about you.

A sacred artifact forged from a fragment of the Pillar with a high-pressure water jet. It is currently the most feasible plan. ||| Fitted with a tube made of salt crystal, it can project the Pillar at a target without touching it directly. ||| If the target is human, their entire body crystallizes within seconds and they die. No means of revival is possible.

Since the true nature of the Pillar remains unexplained, it should certainly not be used lightly, and problems have been pointed out from a humanitarian standpoint. ||| However, please remember that it is an extremely effective artifact when a target must be eliminated without fail.
...Research is scheduled to continue.

Addendum on this sacred artifact: ||| Year **, Month *: trial use begins, restricted to covert operations. Year **, Month *: the Inquisition orders its use against the elimination of *****. Year **, Month *: used in the elimination of ***** (fired from a crossbow). ||| The result was excellent, with no damage to the surroundings. The target ***** was completely erased.

Note regarding the erased person *****: ||| ***** was an orphan of the Salt Pillar incident. Brief history: ||| S.1180: joined the Septian Church. S.1185: entered the Sealing Ministry and became an officer. ||| S.1190: promoted to bishop. S.1195: declared a heretic and excommunicated.
Episode: The Salt Pillar ~Fin~
Obtained 3500 Mira.
Phantom Thief B Investigative Report: A study of his criminal record and background. ||| Compiled by the Imperial Chronicle investigation team.

As the vast materials we collected attest, Phantom Thief B's exploits in the Empire are spectacular. ||| It began with several paintings held in the Imperial Museum. Then septium crystals from a customs warehouse, and a new tank from an Imperial Army research facility... Nothing he set his eyes on was left unharmed. ||| (He even disguised himself as a young officer, infiltrated a party, and eloped with a certain marchioness.)

However (and this is the baffling part), he hardly seemed to profit from any of it. ||| In most cases, the goods he took were abandoned in places that would make their owners faint on seeing them, ||| or converted into Mira and rained down on some corner of the slums.

But make no mistake: Phantom Thief B is by no means a mere gentleman thief. ||| A good example is that marchioness. In the half year or more since the elopement, her whereabouts remain unknown. ||| So there are cases where the prey he targets never comes back at all.
His divinely inspired theft techniques and his incoherent attitude toward the loot... ||| At a glance his crimes seem capricious, but looking over the items B targeted, one common philosophy emerges.

For example, the paintings stolen from the museum were all masterpieces by great artists, ||| yet they were works that never got displayed, panned by aristocratic enthusiasts as too difficult to appreciate.

Likewise, the septium crystals in the warehouse had been kept out of sight since being confiscated by customs. ||| The Imperial Army's new tank boasted high performance, but its development was cancelled and it sat gathering dust. ||| (Incidentally, the marchioness was in a similar state. Her husband, the marquis, was absorbed in his mistresses and neglected his wife.)

There is no doubt that B held a principle in mind: to discover the forgotten "beauty" of the world and rescue it from foolish owners. ||| "The Liberation of Beauty" -- the phrase on his calling cards is the proof. ||| A thief who commits crimes not for Mira but for an ideal. Surely his identity, hidden behind the mask, lies within that unique aesthetic.

Several theories about B's identity have already been put forward, ||| but unfortunately they are many in number and none is decisive. ||| (Lately even a fool of an impostor has appeared, claiming "I am Phantom Thief B" and getting himself caught.)
That said, they are not all equally lacking in credibility. ||| Let us introduce three theories that have been especially rumored of late.
[Case 1: "Lovelorn Swindler X"]
[Background]

X is known as a legendary swindler who repeatedly faked his identity and reveled in romances with daughters of the nobility. ||| His features were handsome, and he is said to have been extremely proud.
Born to a poor family in the warm south, X reportedly stole habitually from childhood to earn pocket money. ||| (According to a companion from those days, X has never once been caught stealing.)
Episode: Phantom Thief B Investigative Report ~Fin~
Obtained 10000 Mira.
Orbments: devices that use the Orbal energy of septium to produce all kinds of phenomena. ||| In only half a century since their invention, they have literally remade the world.

From daily goods like heaters and lights to weapons like tanks and cannons that support national defense, life without orbments is now unthinkable. ||| And it is we, the Epstein Foundation, who have driven their spread and development.

Our Foundation was established in S.1155, ||| carrying out the will of Dr. Epstein, who had died the year before, by several of his gifted disciples. ||| Our headquarters was set up in the Lemans Free State, the doctor's homeland, and we continue to operate from there.

In our early days the Foundation was small, and though we promoted orbments in various regions, the response was far from favorable. ||| To break this deadlock, some researchers left the Lemans Free State to sow the seeds of Orbal technology by their own efforts.
One was Dr. G. Schmidt. ||| Already renowned as an authority on mechanical engineering, he visited companies in many nations and preached the benefits of orbments.

Next was Dr. L. Hamilton. ||| Aware of the technological gap, he believed from the start that "orbments are most needed in the frontier." ||| With the cooperation of the Bracer Guild, with whom he was already close, he formed a dispatch team to promote technology in remote regions. ||| He toured many areas himself and laid the groundwork for promotion and education.

And last was Dr. A. Russell, now even called the "Father of the Orbal Revolution." ||| He returned to his homeland and devoted himself to advancing technology in Liberl. ||| Just one year after returning, he founded the Zeiss Technical Workshop (later the Central Workshop) and succeeded in manufacturing orbments for the first time outside the Lemans Free State.

Three years later, the then-king of Liberl, Edgar III, visited the workshop and gave substantial financial aid. ||| Orbments soon spread throughout the Liberl Kingdom, and it began to show a prosperity that other nations envied.

The kingdom's success completely changed people's perception of orbments, which had not been well regarded until then. ||| After that, calls for technical cooperation reached the Foundation from many nations, and its financial footing became firm.
Wide-ranging appeals and steady, reliable research: ||| it was thanks to the efforts of our predecessors that orbments spread so rapidly, in what later came to be called the Orbal Revolution.

The Foundation's activities rest on three pillars: ||| 1. Basic research on orbments. 2. Promotion and education about orbments. 3. Contributing to world peace through technology. ||| Let us introduce each in turn.
[1. Basic Research on Orbments]
The Foundation's most important mission is, of course, improving orbments and developing them further.

The operating principle of orbments does not change, but their internal structure, called the "basic architecture," has been greatly improved several times. ||| The basic architecture is a mechanism made of mechanical parts like gears and screws, so there is still room for improvement as engineering advances.

Such basic research can yield great results, but it is known to take a long time, and profit-minded companies tend to avoid it. ||| For the Foundation to lead research in this field is extremely important from the standpoint of the public good.
[2. Promotion and Education about Orbments]

Conveying the spread of orbments and their proper use to the world is also an important mission of the Foundation. ||| They are now everyday tools in advanced nations, but in frontiers, mountains, and other non-urbanized areas, orbments are still not widespread.

To raise living standards in such areas, the Foundation has repeatedly formed regional teams of bracers and engineers and provided technical support. ||| We also cooperate with the Septian Church, adding a subject called "Orbal" to the Sunday school curriculum, and work to spread technical knowledge.
[3. Contributing to World Peace through Technology]
Contributing to world peace: ||| for this noble mission, the Foundation has kept close ties with the Bracer Guild since its founding.

Established as an international peacekeeping organization, the Guild mediates international disputes from a neutral position and is indispensable to the stability of today's world. ||| Besides funding, we have backed the Guild with equipment, as the world's only producer of tactical orbments.

It goes without saying that the lessons from real combat gained along the way played a major role in improving tactical orbments. ||| Any machine hides a long and painful history before it reaches a refined form.
S.1190: ||| Looking toward the future of Orbal civilization, the Foundation and the Zeiss Central Workshop announced the "Orbal Network" initiative.
This grand plan to link the whole continent in an Orbal communications network carries our hopes. ||| It is a search for peace through dialogue.

In recent years, the relationship between orbments and "peace" has become more complicated than ever. ||| Dr. Epstein said, "The orbment that realizes an endless cycle of energy will bring lasting stability to the world." ||| Betraying those words, the world after the Orbal Revolution has followed a path of confusion.

In the conflict between the Erebonia Empire and the Liberl Kingdom, Orbal weapons such as airships were used. ||| The trend of Orbal weaponry will continue and will make the results of war ever more tragic.

Faced with such a reality, how can we build a peaceful world? ||| The future opened by Orbal communications, a power that binds people across borders and races, may hold the key to a solution. ||| People talking and deepening understanding beyond national frameworks, and together building a world without conflict...
The challenge toward the ideal world to come has only just begun.
Episode: The Epstein Foundation ~Fin~
Obtained 7000 Mira.

[Report on the Attacks on the Imperial Bracer Guild Branches] ||| In S.1202, a series of attacks on Guild branches occurred throughout the Erebonia Empire. ||| The armed group's identity was unknown. Guild personnel in the Empire fell into confusion.
At once, a huge volume of Orbal communications flew across the skies of the Imperial capital, and the situation grew rapidly more serious.

[From: Imperial Army Intelligence, Section 1. To: General Staff] ||| "Before dawn yesterday, the Bracer Guild's Imperial branch was destroyed by high-explosive attack. Section 2's analysis indicates the explosives were likely planted beneath the facility via the sewers." ||| "The method and type of explosives suggest an operation by a specialized organization. We are confirming the whereabouts of dangerous persons in the country, in consultation with foreign intelligence."

[From: Imperial Army Intelligence, Section 3. To: Section 1] ||| "Among suspects of illegal entry is a person linked to a Jaeger corps, identified as logistics staff of the Jester Jaeger Corps. Please investigate the movements of that corps hiding in the country."

[Imperial Bracer Guild: To the Liberl Kingdom Royal Capital Branch] ||| "It appears the Imperial branch was attacked at dawn today. We still cannot reach the branch staff. We request reinforcement by high-ranking bracers. Urgent, urgent, urgent."

[From: Imperial Army Intelligence, Section 1. To: General Staff] ||| "A transmission was sent from the Imperial Bracer Guild to the Liberl Royal Capital Branch. From its content, a high-ranking bracer is expected to enter the country soon. We request that relevant agencies track and monitor."

Two days after the incident, Cassius Bright (S-rank) arrived in the Imperial capital and took up the post of interim representative of the Guild there. ||| He checked the damage to the branch and ordered the scattered bracers to gather in the frontier. ||| He also completely shut down Orbal communications to guard against enemy intelligence.

Branches in six cities had already been attacked, and the Guild in the Empire was losing its function. ||| He asked the Imperial Army for strict guarding of the surviving branches, but the army's response was slow and it was clear the desired effect would not be achieved.
Meanwhile, the interim representative inferred the enemy's supply base from their movements, ||| selected bracers familiar with the area and sent them to search for the hideout.

His reading was that in an operation in the Empire, with its strict immigration control, they would surely build a supply base in the country. ||| The "let them cut flesh to sever bone" strategy soon bore fruit.

[From: Imperial Army Intelligence, Section 1. To: General Staff] ||| "The reinforcement bracer is confirmed as Cassius Bright. Cassius Bright (S-rank bracer): rated 'LV4', the highest but one in our files. Believed to have led the counteroffensive with patrol airships during the Hundred Days War. ||| He may become an obstacle to security. His movements are under close investigation."

[From: Imperial Army Intelligence, Section 1. To: General Staff] ||| "We failed to track targets C and B. Their whereabouts remain unknown. However, as HQ instructed, the alert level is not raised and the current stage is maintained." ||| "Several bracers are moving by rail. Some kind of operation is suspected."

[From: Imperial Army Intelligence, Section 1. To: General Staff] ||| "Six bracers raided the Jaeger corps base and captured the armed group members inside. By inquiry of our personnel, they were identified as members of the Jester Jaeger Corps."
The raid on the base revealed that the culprits were the Jester Jaeger Corps. ||| However, the enemy group grew passive, and thereafter both sides were left probing each other's moves.
